load_pretrained_compression_model: load a pretrained audio compression model like dac_44khz or facebook/encodec_24khz using CompressionModel.get_pretrained
encode_audio_to_codes: encode an audio waveform tensor into discrete codes using EncodecModel.encode for compression
decode_codes_to_audio: decode discrete codes back into a reconstructed audio waveform using EncodecModel.decode
wrap_stereo_compression_model: wrap a mono compression model to support stereo audio with InterleaveStereoCompressionModel
set_active_codebooks: set the active number of codebooks on a compression model using set_num_codebooks to control bandwidth
